SelectionNet (MLP)
nodes.rationale: MLP mapping channel H and sensing direction psi0 to a connection matrix S of shape (batch, Nt, Nrf); replaces the fixed hand-built sub-connected mask with a learned, per-sample mask because no ground-truth assignment exists.

nodes.label: PGA_Unfold_JX (frozen UPGA beamformer)
nodes.rationale: Beamformer is frozen during SelectionNet training (requires_grad_(False), eval()); only the assignment network learns, so the network only reshuffles which antennas connect to which RF chains.

nodes.label: Unsupervised physics loss: -(OMEGA * sum_rate + mean_CRB)
nodes.rationale: There is no ground-truth antenna-to-RF-chain assignment, so SelectionNet is trained with the same unsupervised physics loss used for the UPGA step sizes (get_sum_loss = -(OMEGA * sum_rate + mean_CRB)).

nodes.label: Gumbel-softmax discretization
nodes.rationale: Makes the discrete antenna-to-RF-chain assignment differentiable via the reparameterization trick (Gumbel noise added to logits, then row-wise softmax); during training hard=False so gradients can flow to selnet.

nodes.label: Gumbel temperature annealing (tau 2.0 -> 0.1)
nodes.rationale: tau decays exponentially over epochs so the soft mask sharpens toward one-hot as training progresses (exploration at high tau, sharpening at low tau).

nodes.label: Straight-through estimator
nodes.rationale: In hard mode the forward pass returns one-hot values but the backward pass keeps soft-probability gradients, making the discrete mask differentiable.

nodes.label: Load-balancing regularizer
nodes.rationale: Optional term loss += SELNET_LOAD_BALANCE_WEIGHT * selnet.column_load(S).std(dim=-1).mean(); off by default (weight 0.0).

nodes.label: Learned per-sample sub-connected mask
nodes.rationale: SelectionNet maps H and psi0 to connection matrix S; each row is a soft/hard distribution over RF chains and antenna n is assigned to the RF chain with the largest entry, replacing the fixed hand-built sub-connected mask.

nodes.label: Gradient flow: loss -> get_sum_loss -> F_eff=F*S -> S -> gumbel_softmax -> logits -> selnet
nodes.rationale: Only selnet.parameters() are updated; F and W are detached by the no_grad block; F_eff = F * S.unsqueeze(0) broadcasts the mask over the K dimension, zeroing unselected antenna-to-RF-chain paths.
